name: 4-way Parallel Radix Sort
aliases: Fast 4-way parallel radix sorting on GPUs
definition: A GPU-based sorting algorithm that processes 2-bit radix pairs in parallel across four digits simultaneously to sort 32-bit keys (including floats mapped to integers) in ceil(n/2) passes.
summary: A GPU radix sort processing two bits per iteration that halves passes and enables coalesced memory writes by clustering elements, unlike binary-radix sort.
